search_rule: Rank equal-window mean utility delta per 10000 versus always normal, then worst-window delta, then fewer depth, trees, then stronger L2. No early stopping or extra search.
catboost_branches: Retest all groups on CB0 and on the best complex candidate among CB1..CB5. Preserve overall search winner separately; testing a complex branch is not a claim that it wins.
xgboost_branches: Retest all groups on the best of X0..X5.
group_rule: Each group independently added to its own fixed-10 branch. Accept if mean paired utility per10000 >0 and at least2/3 dev windows improve. Rejected groups not automatically combined.
combined_rule: If at least two groups accepted on a branch, fit their union once; accept by same rule versus branch fixed10. Final branch model is highest-ranked eligible base/single/combined; accepted groups need not all appear in final winner.
family_final: Best ranked eligible final across family branches, tie by fewer inputs. CatBoost old controls remain eligible.
xgboost_encoding: Native categorical hist; per-fold vocabularies fitted only on fitting period, saved as JSON; future unseen levels mapped to missing, known string levels stable; no target encoding outside learner. Numeric NaN preserved.
threshold: Per run and fold, select exact tie-aware utility maximum only on preceding threshold window; equal optimum favors fewer flags; no June tuning.
weights_and_sampling: Natural prevalence, all fitting rows; no class weights or oversampling. XGBoost subsample and colsample both1.
history: Reuse immutable v2 audited strictly-past label-free cache; no new historical label features, no absolute date/identity key inputs.
june: Previously observed and evaluated; generate this version June predictions only after both family selections locked. Reused diagnostic only, no reselection.
official_test: Never load as feature table; no predictions, no submission.
limits: Same development windows reused for search, optimistic selection results; no new independent test. Same depth/tree budget does not imply equal algorithm capacity. Added inputs do not logically require higher complexity. Capacity interaction assessed against CB0 group controls. No further candidates after results.
